title: Love of God
definition: The love of God is His holy, faithful, gracious, and self-giving commitment to seek the good of His people according to His perfect character and purposes.
summary: God's love is holy, faithful, gracious, and most clearly revealed in Jesus Christ.
christFocus: The love of God is displayed supremely in Christ, who gave Himself for sinners so that they might be reconciled to God and receive eternal life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's love is not sentimental weakness or approval of sin. It is holy love, flowing from His perfect nature. God loves with faithfulness, wisdom, mercy, justice, and truth. His love is never separated from His holiness.

Scripture reveals God's love in creation, patience, provision, covenant faithfulness, discipline, mercy, and especially redemption. The clearest display of divine love is the sending of the Son. God loved not because sinners were worthy, but because He is gracious.

The love of God gives believers assurance, comfort, and strength. It does not promise a painless life, but it promises that those who belong to Christ are held by a faithful Father whose love is deeper than their weakness, suffering, or failure.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people define love by emotion, approval, or personal comfort. The love of God corrects those shallow definitions. It shows that true love is holy, sacrificial, truthful, faithful, and redemptive. This doctrine comforts wounded hearts and confronts false views of love.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive God's love through Christ rather than trying to earn it. Let His love move you toward worship, repentance, security, and love for others. When circumstances are painful, measure God's love by the cross before you measure it by your situation.
